title: 인공지능 발전과 신뢰 기반 조성 등에 관한 기본법

policy_extraction.issuing_body: National Assembly of the Republic of Korea
covered_actors: AI business operators (인공지능사업자), including AI development business operators (인공지능개발사업자) and AI utilizing/deploying business operators (인공지능이용사업자), including offshore operators whose conduct affects the Korean domestic market or users
Domestic representatives (국내대리인) designated by qualifying foreign AI business operators
State agencies, local governments, and public institutions (국가기관등)
Small and medium-sized enterprises, venture enterprises, and small business owners (중소기업등)
AI research institutes (인공지능연구소), universities, and research institutions
Korea Artificial Intelligence Promotion Association (한국인공지능진흥협회) and private voluntary AI ethics committees (민간자율인공지능윤리위원회)

evidence.quote:
① 인공지능사업자는 학습에 사용된 누적 연산량이 대통령령으로 정하는 기준 이상인 인공지능시스템의 안전성을 확보하기 위하여 다음 각 호의 사항을 이행하여야 한다.
1. 인공지능 수명주기 전반에 걸친 위험의 식별ㆍ평가 및 완화
evidence.quote_en: An AI business operator shall implement the following to ensure safety of an AI system whose cumulative training compute meets or exceeds the Presidential Decree threshold: 1. Identification, assessment, and mitigation of risks across the AI lifecycle.

evidence.quote: ① 인공지능사업자가 고영향 인공지능을 이용한 제품 또는 서비스를 제공하는 경우 사전에 사람의 기본권에 미치는 영향을 평가(이하 “영향평가”라 한다)하기 위하여 노력하여야 한다.
evidence.quote_en: Where an AI business operator provides a product or service using high-impact AI, it shall endeavor to assess in advance the impact on human fundamental rights (impact assessment).

evidence.quote:
2. 인공지능 관련 안전사고를 모니터링하고 대응하는 위험관리체계 구축
② 인공지능사업자는 제1항 각 호에 따른 사항의 이행 결과를 과학기술정보통신부장관에게 제출하여야 한다.
evidence.quote_en: 2. Establishment of a risk management system to monitor and respond to AI-related safety incidents. (2) An AI business operator shall submit the implementation results of each item in paragraph (1) to the Minister of Science and ICT.

evidence.quote: ① 인공지능사업자는 고영향 인공지능이나 생성형 인공지능을 이용한 제품 또는 서비스를 제공하려는 경우 제품 또는 서비스가 해당 인공지능에 기반하여 운용된다는 사실을 이용자에게 사전에 고지하여야 한다.
evidence.quote_en: Where an AI business operator intends to provide a product or service using high-impact AI or generative AI, it shall notify users in advance that the product or service operates based on such AI.

evidence.quote: 2. 기술적으로 가능한 범위에서의 인공지능이 도출한 최종결과, 인공지능의 최종결과 도출에 활용된 주요 기준, 인공지능의 개발ㆍ활용에 사용된 학습용데이터의 개요 등에 대한 설명 방안의 수립ㆍ시행
evidence.quote_en: 2. Establishing and implementing measures to explain, to the extent technically feasible, the final output derived by AI, the main criteria used to derive the final output, and an overview of the training data used to develop and utilize the AI.

evidence.quote: ② 인공지능사업자는 생성형 인공지능 또는 이를 이용한 제품 또는 서비스를 제공하는 경우 그 결과물이 생성형 인공지능에 의하여 생성되었다는 사실을 표시하여야 한다.
evidence.quote_en: Where an AI business operator provides generative AI or a product or service using it, it shall indicate/label that the output was generated by generative AI.

evidence.quote: ③ 인공지능사업자는 인공지능시스템을 이용하여 실제와 구분하기 어려운 가상의 음향, 이미지 또는 영상 등의 결과물을 제공하는 경우 해당 결과물이 인공지능시스템에 의하여 생성되었다는 사실을 이용자가 명확하게 인식할 수 있는 방식으로 고지 또는 표시하여야 한다.
evidence.quote_en: Where an AI business operator provides virtual audio, image, or video outputs difficult to distinguish from reality using an AI system, it shall notify or label in a manner users can clearly recognize that the output was generated by an AI system.

evidence.quote: 5. 안전성ㆍ신뢰성 확보를 위한 조치의 내용을 확인할 수 있는 문서의 작성과 보관
evidence.quote_en: 5. Preparation and retention of documents capable of verifying the details of measures taken to ensure safety and trustworthiness.

evidence.quote: ③ 인공지능사업자가 고영향 인공지능을 제공하는 경우 사전에 검ㆍ인증등을 받도록 노력하여야 한다.
evidence.quote_en: Where an AI business operator provides high-impact AI, it shall endeavor to obtain prior verification and certification.

evidence.quote: ① 인공지능사업자는 학습에 사용된 누적 연산량이 대통령령으로 정하는 기준 이상인 인공지능시스템의 안전성을 확보하기 위하여 다음 각 호의 사항을 이행하여야 한다.
evidence.quote_en: An AI business operator shall implement safety assurance measures for AI systems whose cumulative computation used for training is at or above the threshold prescribed by Presidential Decree.

evidence.quote: 4. 고영향 인공지능에 대한 사람의 관리ㆍ감독
evidence.quote_en: 4. Human management and supervision over high-impact AI.

evidence.quote: 2. 기술적으로 가능한 범위에서의 인공지능이 도출한 최종결과, 인공지능의 최종결과 도출에 활용된 주요 기준, 인공지능의 개발ㆍ활용에 사용된 학습용데이터의 개요 등에 대한 설명 방안의 수립ㆍ시행
evidence.quote_en: 2. Establishing and implementing measures to explain, to the extent technically feasible, the final output, key criteria, and overview of training data used in developing and utilizing the high-impact AI.

3. 인공지능안전 평가 기준ㆍ방법 연구

evidence.quote: 제7조제9항을 위반하여 직무상 알게 된 비밀을 타인에게 누설하거나 직무상 목적 외의 용도로 사용한 자는 3년 이하의 징역 또는 3천만원 이하의 벌금에 처한다.

enforcement_authorities: Ministry of the Interior and Safety (행정안전부 — public data consultation under Art. 6(3))
Relevant central administrative agencies and local governments (관계 중앙행정기관 및 지방자치단체)
compliance_deadlines: 2026-01-22: General effective date of the AI Basic Act (one year after promulgation on 2025-01-21 under Addenda Art. 1)
2026-01-24: Effective date of digital medical devices clause within the high-impact AI definition (Art. 2(4)(라), Addenda Art. 1 proviso)
2026-07-21: Effective date of amended Art. 16(3)-(5) regarding public-sector priority procurement of AI products/services and officer indemnity (enacted via 2026-01-20 amendment)
Every 3 years: Formulation and implementation of the AI Basic Plan (인공지능 기본계획) by MSIT (Art. 6(1))
5 years from effective date (until 2031-01-21): Statutory sunset duration of the National AI Strategy Committee (Art. 7(13))
policy_extraction.penalties_summary: Administrative fines (과태료) up to KRW 30 million imposed by the Minister of Science and ICT for failing to give prior AI transparency notice under Art. 31(1), failing to designate a domestic representative under Art. 36(1), or failing to comply with cease-and-desist or corrective orders issued under Art. 40(3) after fact-finding investigations (Art. 43). Criminal penalties of up to 3 years imprisonment or up to KRW 30 million criminal fine apply to National AI Strategy Committee members who divulge or misuse official secrets under Art. 7(9) (Art. 42), and non-official Committee members and entrusted-entity staff are deemed public officials for Criminal Act bribery/secrecy offenses (Art. 41). MSIT may also issue corrective orders or revoke establishment permits of AI research institutes (Art. 22-2(10)) and cancel AI cluster designations (Art. 23(3)).
policy_extraction.implementation_notes: Enacted as Act No. 20676 on 2025-01-21 and consolidated with pre-enforcement amendments of 2025-10-01 and 2026-01-20 (renaming the presidential body to the National AI Strategy Committee, adding Art. 22-2 AI research institutes, Art. 10(4) AI Officer Council, and Art. 16(3)-(4) public procurement priority/indemnity). Establishes South Korea's omnibus framework combining broad industrial promotion (Arts. 13-26) with extraterritorial trust and safety rules (Arts. 27-36) covering generative AI disclosure/labeling, cumulative-compute safety assurance, high-impact AI risk/human-oversight/documentation duties, voluntary certification and impact assessments, and foreign domestic representatives. Explicitly excludes AI developed or used solely for national defense or national security (Art. 4(2)) and contains no EU-style prohibited AI deployment practices.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: South Korea's AI Basic Act is dominantly framed around innovation_enablement: it treats sound AI development and a light-touch foundation of trust as mutually reinforcing tools to respect operators' creativity, support R&D, SMEs, startups, testbeds, datacenters, and regulatory sandboxes, and accelerate private and public adoption across society. Innovation_enablement edges out fundamental_rights and economic_competitiveness because the bulk of the statute (Articles 13–26 and its voluntary, promotion-first governance architecture) is geared toward enabling safe AI deployment and lowering friction rather than imposing prohibitive rights-based bans, while still anchoring Article 1 and high-impact AI rules explicitly in protecting citizens' rights, human dignity, and fundamental rights (fundamental_rights). Economic_competitiveness is a nearly co-equal secondary rationale through explicit statutory goals to strengthen national competitiveness, industrial ecosystems, global talent attraction, and overseas export expansion, complemented by consumer_public_safety protections for life, bodily safety, and property against AI risks.

evidence_spans.quote_en: To strengthen the competitiveness of the AI industry and promote overseas market entry, the Government may provide the following support to individuals, enterprises, or organizations engaged in the AI industry.

evidence_spans.quote: 정부는 인공지능이 국민의 생활에 미치는 잠재적 위험을 최소화하고 안전한 인공지능의 이용을 위한 신뢰 기반을 조성하기 위하여 다음 각 호의 시책을 마련하여야 한다.
evidence_spans.source_section: 제29조(인공지능 신뢰 기반 조성을 위한 시책의 마련)
evidence_spans.quote_en: The Government shall formulate the following policies to minimize potential risks posed by AI to citizens' lives and establish a foundation of trust for safe AI utilization.
